paper_title: Searching for Low-Mass Axions using Resonant Upconversion
notes: UPLOAD room-temperature resonant upconversion haloscope (power technique). Excludes axions with masses 1.12-1.20 ueV (271.7-290.3 MHz beat frequency) above g_agamma ~ 3e-6 GeV^-1 at 95% CL after 30 days. The same limit applies equivalently to the QEMD monopole coupling g_aBB. Exact numerical exclusion curve only shown in Fig. 7; abstract-quoted value 3e-6 1/GeV used as approximately flat limit over the stated mass range. Assumes standard virialized halo (Maxwell-Boltzmann, vc = 226 km/s) but no explicit local DM density value stated in text. Systematic uncertainty on g_agamma ~26%.
